Your exploration companion for AION 2. Organize gathering, find cube locations and follow the day's events.
Suas visitas e preferências ficam neste: Your visits and preferences stay on this computer. Maps and schedules work offline.
Os mapas indicam locais possíveis; confi: Maps show possible locations; confirm objects in the game. The schedule uses the profile selected in Events.
O Strigoi funciona ao lado do AION 2. Os: Strigoi runs alongside AION 2. Markers, the event panel and Sonar alerts appear in external overlay windows over the game. To track the map, the app analyzes the screen image; Sonar receives application audio through Windows. The atlas and schedule use local data.
Não injetamos código nas DLLs do jogo, n: We do not inject code into the game's DLLs, modify its files or read its memory. Strigoi draws its own overlays outside the AION 2 process.
O Sonar foi desenvolvido exclusivamente: Sonar was developed exclusively as an accessibility feature to help deaf and hard-of-hearing people find hidden cubes more easily. It turns an in-game sound cue into a visual alert, reducing reliance on hearing while exploring.
O aviso indica um som compatível com a r: The alert indicates a sound matching the reference and may fail. It does not confirm a cube's presence or provide its exact location.
